relationships.subject: TMJ arthritis
relationships.evidence_quote: In the TMJ, the TMJ/RA‐24h and TMJ/RA‐7d groups showed a significant increase in MMP‐9 immunoexpression in the articular cartilage compared to the TMJ/C group (p < 0.0001).

relationships.subject: knee arthritis
relationships.evidence_quote: In the knee, MMP‐9 immunoexpression was significantly higher in arthritic animals (K/RA‐24h and K/RA‐7d) compared to non‐arthritic animals at both euthanasia time points

relationships.subject: TMJ arthritis
relationships.evidence_quote: arthritic rats with TMJ involvement exhibited increased pain sensitivity even in the absence of inflammation and joint damage, suggesting a process of central pain sensitization

key_findings: mBSA arthritis raised cartilage MMP-9 and lowered nociceptive threshold in both TMJ and knee; the TMJ showed histological and collagen repair at 7 days while knee damage persisted.
Nociceptive threshold stayed reduced in the TMJ despite tissue recovery, suggesting central sensitization.
